name: Route Group Shell Partitioning
Action: Using parenthesized folders such as (marketing) and (console) to give distinct application sections separate layouts without adding URL prefixes.
reason: Keeps public and workspace URLs clean while isolating navigation chrome and layout bundles.

name: Parallel Slot Fault Isolation
Action: Defining @invoices and @usage parallel slots with independent loading.tsx and error.tsx boundaries.
reason: Allows one dashboard panel to fail and retry without unmounting healthy sibling panels.

name: Dual-Context Intercepted Modal
Action: Pairing a @modal parallel slot with an intercepting route like (.)asset/[id] alongside a canonical /asset/[id] route.
reason: Preserves background context in an overlay on soft navigation while rendering a full standalone page on hard reload.

name: Hard-Reload Slot Fallback (default.tsx)
Action: Providing a default.tsx file in every parallel @slot directory.
reason: Prevents Next.js from returning a 404 when a hard reload hits a sub-route that only exists in a sibling slot.
